about_the_game:
For everyone who misses the golden age of Kinect, this is for you.

We wanted to bring back that magic of getting off the couch and using your whole body to play. Catch These Hands is our modern take on that dream, built to run with the hardware you already own: a simple webcam.

Using advanced MediaPipe tracking, we translate your real-world hand movements into in-game actions with stunning accuracy. Every strike has weight, every block feels real, and every enemy reacts to your physical presence. This isn't about pressing buttons; it's about intuitive, physical fun.

What You'll Experience:

  • You Are The Controller: Your hands are recreated in-game with dynamic physics, allowing for natural and immersive interaction. If you can do it in real life, you can do it in the game.

  • Relentless Combat: Survive against waves of tenacious, liquid-metal enemies that will swarm, grab, and keep you on your toes.

  • Fitness That Fights Back: With an integrated calorie tracker, you can turn every play session into a genuine, heart-pounding workout. Compete against yourself and the leaderboards.

The Journey is Just Beginning:

This is a passion project for the motion gaming community. Our immediate roadmap is focused on implementing full Face and Body landmark detection, paving the way for advanced mechanics and entirely new game modes that will push the boundaries of what webcam gaming can be.

If you've been waiting for the next evolution of motion control, welcome home.
